title: Review & Reputation Response
summary: Every review answered fast and in-voice; negative reviews escalated with a recovery play, never auto-answered.

trigger.description: New review appears on a monitored platform.

agents.name: monitor
agents.role: Watches review platforms; classifies sentiment and severity; detects review-bombing patterns.

agents.name: responder
agents.role: Drafts platform-appropriate responses in the client's voice; positive reviews thanked specifically, not generically.

agents.name: recovery
agents.role: For negative reviews: drafts the private recovery outreach and the public holding response; always escalates to the account owner.

rollback: Disable the review.posted trigger; drafted-but-unpublished responses remain in the approval queue. Published responses stand.
